newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA 494 FOR EIGHT LUNCH V WEST INDIES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA 494 FOR EIGHT LUNCH V WEST INDIES.

text.p: Australia were 494 for eight at lunch on the third day of their fourth test match against the West Indies at the Adelaide Oval on Monday.
Australia - 494 for eight from 156 overs (Overnight 434 for five) - (Matthew Hayden 125, Mark Waugh 82, Greg Blewett 99, Michael Bevan 71 not out).
West Indies first innings - 130 in 47.5 overs (Michael Bevan four for 31, Shane Warne three for 42.)
